messages:
mira: Scheduling phased rollout for v2.3.1 across regions — order: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC. Hold at each region for capacity + smoke checks. Pin routes to sha-abc123. TL;DR: canaries per region, warm pool standby, rollback on >3% 5m errors OR p99 latency >750ms.

deploy-bot: Kick accepted by deploy-bot. Preflight dry-run OK. Canary slice: 2% traffic. Warm pool prepped: US=10 GPUs, EU=6, APAC=4. Run: `deploybot start --version sha-abc123 --slice US --canary 2%`.

sam: @mira will ops run live capacity probes during the holds? I have a throughput test ready.

jin: I'll run smoke + synthetic load from US and report p99/p50.

deploy-bot: US canary started 18:00:05 UTC. Allocated instances: gpu-us-3, gpu-us-4. Health checks passing. Smoke results: p50 45ms, p95 210ms, p99 420ms. Errors 0.10%.

derek: US warm pool occupancy at 62% baseline. ~18% headroom for spikes. Recommend proceed to EU after 15m stable.

mira: Proceeding to EU after 15m hold. Pins: set EU route pin to sha-abc123. @ops-oncall stand by for rollback triggers.

ops-oncall: Ack. Alerts configured: error_pct_5m > 3% => notify #incidents + pause deploy. p99_latency > 750ms for 2 consecutive probes => auto-pin back.

sam: Running throughput test against EU now. Preliminary p99 380ms, errors 0.2%.

deploy-bot: EU canary initiated 18:17:30 UTC. Allocated gpu-eu-1, gpu-eu-2. Health initial pass. Smoke: p50 60ms, p95 240ms, p99 460ms. Errors 0.15%.

jin: Observed KV cache warmup lag in EU for long sequences — first-token p99 spike ~980ms for ~60s then normalized. Expected behavior; no rollback.

derek: EU capacity headroom lower (~12%) because of other tenants. Recommend slowing canary growth. If sustained occupancy >65% do not progress.

mira: Noted. Slow EU ramp to a 5% max growth. APAC scheduled after EU stable and warm-pool top-ups confirmed. Release notes draft: "v2.3.1: runtime optimizer fixes, KV cache warmup improvements, minor streaming fix."

sam: Reminder: Dedicated customers in APAC may require manual reserve commit if we hit thermal/capacity limits.

deploy-bot: EU canary holding at 3% traffic. No errors. Next step requires manual approval to continue regional promote.

mira: Approving EU to full region if stable for next 20m. @ops-oncall monitor. Also pre-configuring fallback model variant (quantized) sha-abc123-q8 as downgrade path.

ops-oncall: Fallback route wired into routing policy. If instance OOM >=2 within 10m -> switch to q8 variant and notify.

deploy-bot: APAC window scheduled 19:10 UTC. Pre-warm started; allocating 4 GPUs (gpu-apac-1..4). Warm pool top-up ETA ~4m.

jin: Running final smoke against pre-warm APAC nodes. Results: initial p99 520ms (cache cold), then 260ms after warmup. Errors ~0.3%.

derek: APAC thermal sensors OK. Capacity headroom ~22% after top-up.

mira: Cut APAC canary to 1% at 19:10. If stable 10m -> bump to 7% -> 20% -> finish.

sam: Audit command logged: `deploybot promote --version sha-abc123 --region APAC --step 1 --pin true`.

deploy-bot: APAC canary 1% started 19:10:12 UTC. Health: pass. Smoke: p95 250ms, p99 500ms. Errors 0.40%.

mira: Good. Reminder: if any region hits alert, immediate pin back to previous stable sha-abc000 and open rollback ticket. Update release notes with timestamps and model pin details.

ops-oncall: Rollback ticket template created and ready; automated incident notification wired to #incidents on threshold breaches.

sam: :thumbsup: We'll keep a 30m watch after full rollout for metric stabilization and infra noise.

jin: Note: enabling cache prefetch `prefetch=1` reduced APAC first-token spikes — recommend adding to region rollout params.

mira: Thanks all. I'll post final release notes and the traffic schedule to #announcements after completion. Closing thread for now; will update on any alerts or rollbacks."
